basic_details.job_title: NIPER Research Associate III Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: National Institute of Pharmaceutical Education & Research (NIPER), SAS Nagar (Mohali), Punjab, has invited applications for the post of Research Associate -III under Advt No. 31/2026. Applications are to be sent offline and must reach the organisation by 27 November 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: NEFT in the Institute's bank (State Bank of India, SAS Nagar).

age_limit.age_details: Maximum 38 years (as on the last date of submission of applications)

qualification.education_qualification: Post Graduate degree in Public Health/Statistics/Epidemiology/Health Sciences/Life Sciences/Environmental Sciences/HTA/Population Sciences/Demography/Health Economics/M. Pharma (Pharmacy Practice/Pharmacology/Nursing with 03 years of experience, OR Ph.D. in a listed subject
qualification.details: Qualification: Post Graduate degree in Public Health/Statistics/Epidemiology/Health Sciences/Life Sciences/Environmental Sciences/HTA/Population Sciences/Demography/Health Economics/M. Pharma (Pharmacy Practice/Pharmacology/Nursing with 03 years of experience; OR Ph.D. in Public Health/Statistics/Health Sciences/Epidemiology/Environmental Sciences/Life Sciences/Population Sciences/Demography/Health Economics/HTA/Pharmacy Practice/Pharmacology/Clinical Research/Pharmaceutical Sciences Experience: 03 years of experience with the Post Graduate degree route Age limit: Maximum 38 years (as on the last date of submission of applications) Age relaxation: SC/ST/OBC/PwBD etc. As per Government of India rules | Other conditions: | Only eligible Indian nationals can apply The engagement is full time | Desirable: | Publications (Systematic Reviews and Meta-analysis) as first author or corresponding author in SCIE Q1 Journals High-level expertise in conducting data analysis using R Programming/Phyton

exam_pattern.details: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the Written Test and/or Interview.

how_to_apply: Download the application form from https://niper.gov.in/jobs.
Fill in the prescribed proforma and attach attested copies of testimonials, degrees and certificates supporting the qualification and experience columns.
Attach a latest passport size photograph and proof of payment of the application fee (NEFT to the Institute's bank), wherever applicable.

Send the hard copy to Prof. Dipika Bansal, Department of Pharmacy Practice & Clinical Research, NIPER, Sector- 67, SAS Nagar - 160062 (Punjab) by Speed Post, Registered Post, Courier or by hand on or before 27.11.2026.
Also email a scanned copy of the form with all attachments (in .pdf format) to [email protected] with a copy to [email protected] by 27.11.2026.
important_instructions: Keep the email id and mobile number given in the application form active Any change to the schedule will be notified on the Institute's website Canvassing in any form may lead to cancellation of candidature

content_sections.heading: NIPER Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. 31/2026 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download NIPER notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Post Graduate degree in Public Health/Statistics/Epidemiology/Health Sciences/Life Sciences/Environmental Sciences/HTA/Population Sciences/Demography/Health Economics/M. Pharma (Pharmacy Practice/Pharmacology/Nursing with 03 years of experience; OR Ph.D. in Public Health/Statistics/Health Sciences/Epidemiology/Environmental Sciences/Life Sciences/Population Sciences/Demography/Health Economics/HTA/Pharmacy Practice/Pharmacology/Clinical Research/Pharmaceutical Sciences Experience: 03 years of experience with the Post Graduate degree route Age limit: Maximum 38 years (as on the last date of submission of applications) Age relaxation: SC/ST/OBC/PwBD etc. As per Government of India rules Other conditions: Only eligible Indian nationals can apply The engagement is full time Desirable: Publications (Systematic Reviews and Meta-analysis) as first author or corresponding author in SCIE Q1 Journals High-level expertise in conducting data analysis using R Programming/Phyton

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for NIPER Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications without valid proof of fee deposit (where fee applies) will be summarily rejected Candidates with incomplete applications or without supporting enclosures, photographs, signatures and prescribed fee will not be interviewed Candidates who fail to produce original certificates at the interview will not be allowed to appear

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Purely temporary for a period of 01 year, co-terminus with the duration of the project No right or claim for regularization/absorption against any vacant post in the Institute Institute may withdraw the position or choose not to fill it at any time without giving a reason

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: Payment mode: NEFT in the Institute's bank (State Bank of India, SAS Nagar).

content_sections.heading: How Will NIPER Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Shortlisting of applications Interview in person at NIPER-SAS Nagar A written test may be conducted depending on the number of applications received Selection will be based on the performance of the candidate in interview Only shortlisted candidates will be called for interview; call letters are sent by e-mail only

content_sections.heading: NIPER Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the Written Test and/or Interview.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Duly filled application form in the prescribed proforma Attested copies of testimonials, degrees and certificates Experience certificate and reprints of important publications Latest passport size photograph Proof of payment of the application fee, wherever applicable Valid proof for claiming age relaxation

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIPER Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Download the application form from https://niper.gov.in/jobs. Fill in the prescribed proforma and attach attested copies of testimonials, degrees and certificates supporting the qualification and experience columns. Attach a latest passport size photograph and proof of payment of the application fee (NEFT to the Institute's bank), wherever applicable. Send the hard copy to Prof. Dipika Bansal, Department of Pharmacy Practice & Clinical Research, NIPER, Sector- 67, SAS Nagar - 160062 (Punjab) by Speed Post, Registered Post, Courier or by hand on or before 27.11.2026. Also email a scanned copy of the form with all attachments (in .pdf format) to [email protected] with a copy to [email protected] by 27.11.2026.

content_sections.text: Keep the email id and mobile number given in the application form active Any change to the schedule will be notified on the Institute's website Canvassing in any form may lead to cancellation of candidature

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NIPER Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 27 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in NIPER Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Research Associate -III.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for NIPER Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Institute's website https://niper.gov.in/jobs) and send it to Prof. Dipika Bansal, Department of Pharmacy Practice & Clinical Research, National Institute of Pharmaceutical Education and Research (NIPER), Sector- 67, SAS Nagar - 160062 (Punjab), by speed post, registered post, courier or by hand; scanned copy also by email, to reach by 27 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Unreserved and OBC: Rs.500. SC/ST/PwBD/female: NIL.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 38 years (as on the last date of submission of applications). Relaxation: SC/ST/OBC/PwBD etc. As per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 67,000 p.m. + HRA, as admissible.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Post Graduate degree in Public Health/Statistics/Epidemiology/Health Sciences/Life Sciences/Environmental Sciences/HTA/Population Sciences/Demography/Health Economics/M. Pharma (Pharmacy Practice/Pharmacology/Nursing with 03 years of experience, OR Ph.D. in a listed subject.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only eligible Indian nationals can apply. The engagement is full time.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications without valid proof of fee deposit (where fee applies) will be summarily rejected. Candidates with incomplete applications or without supporting enclosures, photographs, signatures and prescribed fee will not be interviewed. Candidates who fail to produce original certificates at the interview will not be allowed to appear.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting of applications. Interview in person at NIPER-SAS Nagar. A written test may be conducted depending on the number of applications received. Selection will be based on the performance of the candidate in interview.
